name: car-ramp-slope-calculator
description: A responsive browser-based car ramp slope, angle, length, and vehicle clearance calculator for GitHub Pages.

paragraphs: Car Ramp Slope Calculator is a browser-based engineering utility for calculating the geometry of a straight vehicle ramp and checking it against vehicle clearance angles supplied by the user. The project is designed for homeowners, trailer users, automotive enthusiasts, workshop operators, contractors, and anyone who needs to understand how steep a ramp is before building, buying, or using it. It runs entirely as a static website, so it can be hosted on GitHub Pages, an ordinary web server, or a local folder served through a lightweight HTTP server.

The tool focuses on the practical questions behind the keyword “car ramp slope calculator.” A user usually does not only want a percentage. They want to know the ramp angle, the actual surface length, the horizontal space required, and whether the front, center, or rear of a vehicle is at risk of touching a transition. The interface therefore combines ramp geometry, optional vehicle clearance checks, a visual side-view diagram, and an actionable recommendation in one screen.

requirements.text: No front-end framework, package runtime, database, external calculation API, account system, or server-side process is required.
The application does not require registration, login, cookies, analytics, cloud storage, or a vehicle identification number.
